blurb: 5678 Dance Studio offers dance classes ranging from toddler to adult, including styles such as Ballet, Tap, Hip-Hop, Jazz, Contemporary, and Lyrical. Classes focus on technique, vocabulary, and choreography appropriate to age and skill level. The studio emphasizes confidence, discipline, and creating a supportive environment for dancers.
